title: Microsoft.Entra/conditionalAccess/authenticationStrengths
description: A custom authentication strength policy. The resource name is the displayName (at most 30 characters); built-in strengths are read-only and can only be referenced.

displayName.description: Set from the resource name; declaring it is only allowed when it equals the name. At most 30 characters (Graph: "Policy DisplayName length cannot be longer than 30 characters").

allowedCombinations.description: Required: authentication method combinations, compared as a set. A combination is one method or a comma-separated list: password, voice, hardwareOath, softwareOath, sms, fido2, windowsHelloForBusiness, microsoftAuthenticatorPush, deviceBasedPush, temporaryAccessPassOneTime, temporaryAccessPassMultiUse, email, x509CertificateSingleFactor, x509CertificateMultiFactor, federatedSingleFactor, federatedMultiFactor, for example fido2 or password,microsoftAuthenticatorPush.

permissions.notes: Learn (authenticationstrengthroot-post-policies, authenticationstrengthpolicy-update/-get): Policy.ReadWrite.ConditionalAccess is the least privileged application permission for create, update and delete; Policy.ReadWrite.AuthenticationMethod is the higher privileged alternative; Policy.Read.All reads. updateAllowedCombinations is not covered by a page of its own that was checked.
